ADHD weekly planning routine that actually works 🧠✨ My everyday planner-> @Sugar Paper LA  If your weeks feel chaotic, this simple system helps you reset, refocus, and stay on track without overwhelm. Here is the weekly planning flow: 1. Brain dump everything on your mind 2. Pick a theme for each day of the week so your week has structure 3. Add your tasks into Google Tasks under each day or theme 4. Break everything into small doable steps 5. Time block your most important work so it actually gets done This is not about being perfect. It is about giving your ADHD brain a simple structure that makes the week feel easier to manage.
